title: Grateful Dead Live at Hofheinz Pavilion - University of Houston on 1972-11-18

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with minor distortion and mix quirks, but a high‑energy second set highlighted by a monster 26‑minute “Playin’ in the Band.”
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that suffers from occasional blown‑speaker distortion and a few sonic balance issues (notably a debated Phil‑loudness), yet it remains listenable. Musically the show shines – the Texas crowd got a scorching second set anchored by an epic 26‑minute “Playin’ in the Band,” plus standout moments like Garcia’s Wah‑Wah on “Greatest Story Ever Told” and Phil’s entrance on “Sugar Magnolia.” Overall sentiment leans positive despite some mixed remarks about the mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is 4.4 ★; strong praise for the performance offsets noted recording flaws, yielding a solid 4.2 ★ overall.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Intermittent distortion from a blown stage speaker (minor), occasional mix/sonic balance issues (Phil’s bass perceived loud by some), but generally clear and usable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second‑set dominates with a long, improvisational jam; transitions flow naturally and keep the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Uses Wah‑Wah pedal on “Greatest Story Ever Told”; praised for attractive playing in the second half of ’72.
band_member_comments.Phil: His bass entry at the start of “Sugar Magnolia” called “pure gold”; some listeners note he sounds loud in the mix, but others disagree.
